name: Physion
description: A video-based benchmark for evaluating AI models' ability to predict physical dynamics compared to human performance. Covers 8 physical scenario types (rolling, sliding, falling, collisions, deformable materials, stable stacking, etc.) using ThreeDWorld Unity3D-based physics simulation. The task is Object Contact Prediction: observe the first portion of a video, then predict whether two objects will make contact during the unseen remainder.
evaluation_method: binary prediction accuracy compared to human performance baseline
typical_sota_score: GNNs with direct physical state access approach human performance; pure vision models fall significantly below human baseline
reputation: NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks track; standard benchmark for physical intuition in vision models; extended by Physion++ (arxiv:2306.15668)
notes: ~2,000 training + 150 test videos per scenario; ~1,200 total evaluation examples. Extended by Physion++ which tests latent physical properties (mass, friction, elasticity, deformability). GitHub: github.com/cogtoolslab/physics-benchmarking-neurips2021. CC-BY licensed.
